postings.title: Lawhive Talent Pool
postings.description:
LAWHIVE TALENT POOL

Don't see a role that would be great for you? Submit an application to register your interest to be contacted for future suitable roles!

A note before you apply:
This is not a live role. While we aim to get back to you as soon as possible, we can only review applications here from time to time, so please don’t worry if you don’t hear from us straight away. We do read every application and if your experience looks a good match, we’ll be in touch.



About Lawhive

We're on a mission to make sure everyone has access to the law.
Lawhive is an online platform for consumers and small businesses to get legal help for a fraction of the cost of a law firm. Our platform combines regulated human lawyers collaborating alongside the world’s first AI lawyer, specifically built for consumer legal work.

Equal access to the law is one of the biggest and most pressing unsolved problems in society today. We’re passionate about leveling the playing field and believe access to the law should be a basic utility in society.

Our AI lawyer Lawrence is built on top of our own fine tuned LLM and recently passed the UK’s bar exam equivalent.

We’re backed by some of the top US and UK VC funds including Google Ventures, Balderton Capital and TQ Ventures. We recently secured a $40M Series A funding round to facilitate international expansion and to grow our team, representing one of the five largest Series A rounds in Europe for 2024.



Get in touch to find out more, and where you could fit in!

postings.title: Senior Product Designer
postings.description:
ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is an AI-native law firm operating in the US and UK. We partner with leading Main Street law firms and give their lawyers and back-office teams what they need to grow faster than they could alone: our own AI platform, plus marketing and operational support.

We build that platform ourselves, alongside the people who use it every day. That means no guessing what users want, no six-month feedback loops, and no compromises to fit someone else’s product. At its heart is Lawrence, our AI agent for legal work. Lawrence takes on the heavy lifting so lawyers can put their judgement where it belongs: at the centre of every matter. We’re a team obsessed with building the best tools in legal.

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.




THE ROLE

We're about to bring hundreds of new users onto our platform, and design shapes how every lawyer and back-office team experiences it.

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll own design for the squad setting the bar for compliance and data visualisation in legal tech, empowering law firm managers to make better decisions. You'll work day to day with a PM and engineers on data-heavy, mission-critical work, designing new agentic UX patterns that lawyers rely on, including how they work alongside AI agents.

You'll take problems from discovery to shipped: talking to users, shaping the solution, prototyping and testing it, and seeing it through with engineering. You'll make the calls, and you'll have the craft to back them up.

And our users are part of the company. You'll have direct access to the people you design for, validate ideas and prototypes with them and ship improvements fast.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - You'll shape how lawyers work with AI. You'll design the patterns that keep human judgement at the centre of every matter, with agents working alongside.

 - You'll have real access to users. Our users are part of the company, so you can test an idea and ship improvements fast.

 - You'll own your squad's design end to end. You'll be part of a small, strong design team, with the scope to set the direction for your area.

 - You’ll be working at the cutting edge of UX. We’re defining new patterns in UX for how users collaborate with agents to get their work done in novel ways.

 - You'll change how an entire industry works. Law is one of the oldest industries and is going through a radical shift that we're driving. What you design changes how lawyers serve their clients.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years designing B2B SaaS products. You've owned end-to-end UX for data-heavy, multi-user products and can show the results.

 - Strong design fundamentals. You’ll be able to demonstrate great skill in UX, UI, layout, type and hierarchy, with real working files behind your portfolio, not just polished slides.

 - User research and validation. You talk to users regularly and turn what you learn into clear decisions.

 - Design conviction. You don't hand over options and wait to be told. You make the call, back it with evidence and bring the team with you.

 - AI-native in how you work. AI is part of how you design every day. You prototype in code, build and test ideas in the browser, and use the latest AI tools to move faster than any traditional design process allows.

 - Ownership and pace. You share work early, act on feedback quickly and keep things moving without being chased.

 - Strong collaboration. You’ll work closely with your PM and engineers, as well as with the wider design team, and you're confident presenting to users and leadership.
   
   

Bonus Points If You Have

 - Experience maintaining, scaling or governing a design system.

 - Experience designing data visualisation or BI products.

 - Experience in legal tech, professional services or another regulated industry.
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - Interview with our Head of Product Design

 - In-person case study: present a project you've shipped, then meet the team

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!
   
   

Benefits

 - 💰 Meaningful early-stage equity at one of Europe’s fastest growing startups

 - ✈️ 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and an extra day for your birthday, moving day and wedding day, with the opportunity to earn up to 5 more days with tenure!

 - 🩺 Private Medical Insurance via Bupa (including subsidised gym membership)

 - 🚲 Cycle to work scheme

 - 🍼 Nursery benefits

 - 💰 Pension contribution via Nest

 - 🌍 Work from anywhere for a month

 - 💻 Top-spec Macbook

 - ⛳️ Regular team building activities and socials!



Diversity at Lawhive

At Lawhive, we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team, and as we scale, we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

We build that platform ourselves, alongside the people who use it every day. That means no guessing what users want, no six-month feedback loops, and no compromises to fit someone else’s product. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

THE ROLE

We’re rapidly acquiring law firms and bringing them onto our platform. Every one comes with its own case management system, its own reporting and its own messy data, and how quickly we bring it together shapes how fast Lawhive can grow.

As our Senior Data Engineer, you’ll own our data engineering, including the hands-on work behind every migration. Working with our Head of Data, you’ll make each migration faster than the last.

You’ll sit at the foundation of a small, AI-native data team, building the pipelines our Analytics Engineer and product analytics rely on, so data actually improves the product. You’ll work alongside our staff engineers and bring the DevOps, infrastructure, security and governance know-how to run your own platform.

Our stack: BigQuery, dbt, Hex, Dagster, K8s, Elementary, Claude Code, GCP and AWS.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - You’ll build data engineering for AI and humans. What you build doesn’t just serve people. It feeds Lawrence, our AI agent for legal work, and makes it better.

 - You’ll make every migration faster than the last. You’ll work out what we can standardise across firms, what needs to stand alone, and how we move faster each time. You’ll work with Analytics Engineering on a shared model that scales to every firm, with the right access and privacy controls in place.

 - You’ll lay the foundations for product insight. Good data engineering leads to good analytics engineering, product analytics and product insight. You’ll build the layer everything else sits on.

 - You’ll own the platform. Pipelines, orchestration, infrastructure, security and governance. You’ll keep BigQuery fast and cost-efficient as volumes grow.

 - You’ll help build the function. The data team is small and the company is scaling fast. There’s real scope to grow into leading a team and building out data engineering as a central function.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Senior data engineering experience at a startup or scale-up. You’ve owned production pipelines and seen your work through to real business outcomes.

 - Data migration and integration. You’ve brought together messy data from very different source systems. The more varied the industries you’ve worked across, the better.

 - Modern tech stack. Strong BigQuery (or similar), Python and orchestration (Dagster, Airflow or similar).

 - Platform engineering. Experience across DevOps, infrastructure, security and governance.

 - AI-native, with opinions. AI is part of how you work every day, and you’re clear on where it helps and where you draw the line.

 - Commercial instinct. You care about what your work does for the business, not just whether the pipeline runs.

 - Interview with our Head of Data

 - Technical interview

postings.title: M&A Integration Lead
postings.description:
Salary: $150k-$250k + a performance-based bonus & share options

Location: New York City + regular travel across the US

 


ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter.

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

 



THE ROLE

We're growing rapidly across the US by partnering with established law firms and transforming how they operate.

Through these partnerships, Lawhive takes responsibility for the firm's back-office operations, bringing teams and processes onto our operating model while giving lawyers access to our AI-powered platform. This involves replacing legacy practice management systems, migrating data and workflows, and improving how firms operate day to day.

As our first M&A Integration Lead, you'll own the end-to-end integration of new partner firms onto Lawhive, overseeing both operational integration and product migration. You'll work closely with our M&A Team as well as teams across Engineering, Data, Product, Finance and Operations to ensure each firm transitions smoothly, from initial planning through to successful go-live.

But this role is about more than delivering individual integrations. We're looking for someone who has done this at scale before and can help us build a better way of doing it. You'll create the processes and playbooks that make every integration faster, smoother and more repeatable, using AI and automation to reduce manual work as we grow.

You'll also spend time onsite with our partner firms, understanding how they operate and helping them successfully adopt our platform.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - You’re the first M&A Integration Lead at Lawhive. You’ll design how Lawhive brings new partner firms onto its platform and build the playbook every future integration runs on.

 - You’ll play a critical role in our US expansion. The speed at which we grow depends on how effectively we bring new firms onto Lawhive. You’ll use AI and automation to make each integration faster, smoother and more scalable.

 - You’ll shape the team. As we grow, we plan to build dedicated M&A Integration teams, and you’ll set the standard for how they operate.

 - You’ll change how law firms work. Law is one of the oldest industries and is going through a radical shift which we’re driving. You’ll be at the forefront of this. Every firm you move onto Lawhive gets the tools to serve clients faster and better.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Proven experience leading high-impact, high-volume integrations. You've owned complex business integrations, platform migrations or implementations end to end, often managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can demonstrate the results.

 - Experience building scalable processes. You've developed or significantly improved migration playbooks, workflows or integration processes, making integrations faster, smoother and more repeatable.

 - A track record of successful go-lives. You've delivered migrations on time, ensuring data accuracy, strong user adoption and minimal disruption to the business.

 - Strong cross-functional project management. You're confident coordinating teams across Engineering, Data, Product, Finance, Operations and external partners, managing dependencies and keeping everyone accountable.

 - Excellent stakeholder management. You build trust, communicate clearly and manage expectations, whether you're working with senior leaders, technical teams or people on the ground.

 - A proactive, organized and data-driven approach. You can manage multiple moving parts, identify risks early and use metrics such as time to go-live, post-launch issues and adoption to continuously improve performance.

 - A hands-on mindset. You're comfortable spending time onsite with partner firms and travelling regularly across the US.

Bonus Points If You Have

 - Experience implementing or migrating case management platforms.

 - Experience working with law firms, legal technology or professional services.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - First stage interview

 - Practical skills assessment interview

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!

 


BENEFITS

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💰 Meaningful early-stage share options

 - 🌍 Work from anywhere for a month

 - 💻 Top-spec Macbook

 - ⛳️ Regular team building activities and socials!



Diversity at Lawhive

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team. We’re not yet where we want to be but as we scale we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

postings.title: Law Librarian
postings.description:
Salary: $120,000-$150,000 + share options




ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.



We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter.



We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.



So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.




The Role

This is a unique role. As Law Librarian at Lawhive, you will be the research and knowledge backbone of our US legal practice, blending traditional law librarianship with training and evaluating our AI agent, Lawrence.



You will conduct deep legal research, check statutes and case law, build and maintain our library of precedents and templates, and manage the taxonomy, databases and knowledge-sharing that our attorneys rely on every day. Alongside this, you will help ensure and enhance the quality of Lawrence, our AI-powered legal platform, by reviewing AI-generated legal content and checking that its citations, statutes and references are accurate and up to date.




Key Responsibilities

 - Conduct in-depth legal research, statutory checks and case law analysis to support our attorneys across practice areas

 - Structure and maintain our internal document archive, including precedents, templates and practice guides

 - Build and manage our legal taxonomy so knowledge is easy to find and consistently organised

 - Manage access to legal research databases (e.g. Westlaw, Lexis, Bloomberg Law) and support attorneys in using them effectively

 - Share knowledge across the group’s firms through research memos, current-awareness updates and training

 - Review legal content, drafts and responses produced by our AI agent, Lawrence, for accuracy and legitimacy

 - Fact-check legal citations, statutes and references generated by the platform, flagging errors and outdated authority

 - Partner with our AI, Product and Engineering teams to feed back on quality issues and help improve how Lawrence handles legal research


What You’ll Bring

 - An MLIS/MLS or equivalent qualification; a JD is a bonus

 - Experience as a law librarian, legal research analyst or similar role in a law firm, law school, court or legal publisher

 - Expert command of US legal research methods and tools

 - A proven interest in AI and how it can be used to improve the legal system; hands-on experience with legal AI tools is a bonus

 - Experience organising legal knowledge (precedent banks, taxonomies, intranets or knowledge management systems)

 - Meticulous attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - Highly motivated, proactive, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritise competing research requests

 - Previous experience in a start-up or scale-up environment considered a bonus



INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - Interview with your hiring manager and founding AI Engineer

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!




BENEFITS

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💻 Top-spec Macbook

postings.title: FP&A Lead
postings.description:
ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter. 

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.




FINANCE AT LAWHIVE

We're a lean finance team working across Lawhive's UK and US group, partnering with every part of the business from product and engineering to legal operations and the exec team. Over the next 12 to 18 months we're focused on:

 - Building the systems, controls and reporting for a multi-entity group on the path to audit

 - Creating real-time, decision-grade data on cash flow, margins and unit economics

 - Bringing acquired entities into one unified finance function

 - Automating workflows across payables, payroll, tax, FP&A and revenue accounting

If you want a finance role where the problems are real and the impact is visible across the whole company, this is it.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced FP&A Lead to build and own financial planning across Lawhive's fast-scaling, multi-entity UK and US group. As our first dedicated FP&A hire, you'll establish the foundations of the function, owning forecasting, budgeting and financial modelling end to end.

This is a role for someone who has built FP&A foundations before, ideally in a startup or scale-up. You'll bring experience standardising financial planning across multiple entities, creating structure from ambiguity and providing senior stakeholders with clear, commercially relevant insights.

Working closely with finance leadership and teams across product, engineering, operations and commercial functions, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, building scalable processes and using automation and AI to improve how we plan and make decisions.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


FORECASTING AND MODELLING

 - Lead group-level forecasting across revenue, headcount, costs and cash flow.

 - Build and own financial models that support strategic planning and investment decisions.

 - Analyse performance, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities.

 - Lead scenario modelling, long-range planning and sensitivity analysis.


BUSINESS PARTNERING

 - Partner with senior leaders to understand performance, risks and future requirements.

 - Translate financial insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

 - Provide commercial and financial guidance on new initiatives and operational decisions.

 - Influence decision-making through strong relationships and high-quality financial analysis.


REPORTING AND INSIGHT

 - Own group-level management reporting, delivering clear analysis and performance insights.

 - Establish consistent reporting across entities, tracking revenue, margins, unit economics and operational KPIs.

 - Improve reporting processes, dashboards and financial data visibility.

 - Ensure accuracy, consistency and audit-ready documentation across financial outputs.


BUILDING THE FUNCTION

 - Establish scalable FP&A processes, tools and reporting frameworks from the ground up.

 - Lead budgeting and standardise planning processes across teams and entities.

 - Partner with Management Accounting on month-end performance, variance analysis and financial insights.

 - Strengthen financial governance and planning discipline across the group.




ABOUT YOU

 - Significant FP&A, commercial finance or strategic finance experience, with proven ownership of financial planning, ideally with exposure to building financial planning processes, models and reporting frameworks from the ground up.

 - Experience building or transforming FP&A processes, ideally in a startup or scale-up environment.

 - Strong multi-entity experience, including standardising planning and reporting at group level.

 - Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, with excellent financial modelling capabilities.

 - Confident analysing complex datasets and translating insights into clear recommendations.

 - Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing strategic decisions.

 - Strong understanding of revenue models, costs, margins and operational metrics.

 - Experience improving financial processes through automation, ideally using AI.

 - Highly analytical, commercially minded and intellectually curious.

 - A hands-on self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure and drives continuous improvement.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - 1:1 with your hiring team

 - Skills assessment interview

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💰 Equity: Options in Lawhive LTD
